lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs in approximately five horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with a higher concentration of smaller, more densely packed blobs in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern, primarily in the dorsal-anterior region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as a sharp horizontal line of contrast in the upper third of the flank, with a high-intensity edge and a corresponding shadow immediately ventral.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of several elongated, lower-luminance pixel clusters (remoras) near the ventral boundary and trailing the pectoral fin.
